messages:
Anna (PM): Heads-up — I'm planning a quick re-score of next quarter's roadmap this afternoon. thinking we should recalibrate how we treat Reach vs Impact for enterprise vs PLG asks. especially with multiple Nimbus Health asks that are high-impact but low-usage so far.
Raj (Eng): Agree we need different lenses. infra-heavy items (KV-cache v2, dedicated-autoscale) look high effort but unlock multiple product bets. want to ensure effort math captures infra reusability.
Maria (Data): Quick data note: our median active users across enterprise trials is 12k/day but lifetime value skew means small changes have outsized ARR impact for a few customers. raw reach numbers understate that.
Lee (Design): From UX: the Nimbus flows need 2 new screens + auth changes. not huge, but increases perceived polish which affects adoption for trials.
Sophie (GTM): Nimbus is already in an RFP pipeline — if we ship core compliance bits, likely $300k ARR in 6 months. should that be treated as higher Impact even if Reach is low?
Casey (Eng): For scoring: can we split Effort into "dev effort" and "infra cost/ops"? infra cost is amortized, dev effort is one-off. Right now RICE folds them together and penalizes infra items too much.
Anna (PM): Proposed quick rule set for today's re-score:
- Reach: active users/inputs normalized per segment (PLG vs enterprise)
- Impact: expected ARR influence + customer reference value (enterprise gets multiplier)
- Confidence: keep as-is but require data or sales validation for >0.7
- Effort: two-part score, dev_effort (1-10) and infra_reuse (multiplier 0.5-1.5). final Effort = dev_effort * infra_reuse
Raj (Eng): That feels actionable. Example: KV-cache v2: dev_effort=8, infra_reuse=0.6 (high reuse) -> Effort=4.8, so it climbs in priority.
Maria (Data): I'll produce a short table mapping historical ARR lift per customer for similar infra projects to help set the Impact multiplier.
Sophie (GTM): +1. Also suggest launch criteria for enterprise items:
- Security: SOC2 gap closed or mitigations documented
- SLO: 99th latency <200ms for median trial load
- Cost: per-token cost delta <10% vs baseline
If those are met, classify as "ship".
Lee (Design): For scope negotiation, propose we split Nimbus deliverable into: pilot MVP (auth + compliance + 1 key workflow) and deluxe (polish + extra workflows). pilot must be the gating scope.
Anna (PM): Good. For sequencing: prioritize infra items that unlock at least two high-impact enterprise asks + one PLG feature. That gives us compound value.
Casey (Eng): One caveat: KV-cache v2 requires kernel updates that will take a spike in QA time. suggest we schedule it early in sprint 1 to reduce rollout risk.
Anna (PM): Decision proposal: use adjusted RICE where Impact uses ARR multiplier, Effort is dev_effort * infra_reuse. We'll re-score the top 20 candidates in the doc and land a final list by EOD tomorrow. anyone opposed?
Raj (Eng): No objections. I'll update effort estimates in the shared sheet.
Maria (Data): Will drop ARR mapping in the sheet by 3pm.
Sophie (GTM): I'll flag Nimbus exec sponsor to speed legal/compliance review.
Lee (Design): I'll create the pilot UI sketches and call out scope cuts for the MVP.
Casey (Eng): I'll add QA spike to sprint 1 draft.
prioritization-bot: Quick poll: "Approve adjusted RICE rule set for Q next quarter re-score?" 1) Approve 2) Discuss 3) Reject
Anna (PM): Please vote in the poll. if we get majority Approve, I'll run the recalibration and post updated ranks.
Raj (Eng): :thumbsup: voted Approve
Maria (Data): voted Approve
Lee (Design): voted Approve
Sophie (GTM): voted Approve
Casey (Eng): voted Discuss (added comment: need a def for "customer reference value")
Anna (PM): Noted — will add a short definition: "customer reference value = how likely the shipped feature converts a pilot to paid + referenceability (0-1)".
Anna (PM): Next actions: 1) Maria + Sophie provide ARR/reference signals; 2) Raj + Casey refine effort and infra_reuse; 3) Lee scopes MVP UI; 4) I'll run the re-score and post new prioritized list by 6pm tomorrow.
Sophie (GTM): Sounds good. thanks all. :rocket:
Anna (PM): Thanks — closing thread for now, will reopen with the new ranked list.
